info.title: US Tax API
info.description: JSON API in front of the Lean calculator. Every money value is an integer number of cents. There is no authentication. Bodies are limited to 256 KiB. The contract is `api/schema.json`; this document is generated from it by `scripts/gen_openapi.mjs`.

post.description: Takes the filer's facts and answers 200 with every Form 1040 line, 422 when something in the request is outside what the calculator supports, or an error body.

200.description: Calculated. Every money value is integer cents; `warnings` lists non-fatal notes.

400.description: The body is not valid JSON, breaks the schema, has an unknown field, or fails a cross-field rule. `details` lists each problem by JSON pointer.

details.message: money must be an integer number of cents

422.description: The request is valid but uses something the calculator does not support yet. No tax is computed; `reasons` says why.

reasons.message: Flow Knockout Has Foreign Tax Paid

500.description: Server fault. Not reproducible from the request.

get.description: Answers 200 `{"status":"ok"}` when the server is up.
Schema semver, tax year and the git commit of the calculator build.

Money.description: Signed integer number of cents (Lean `Money`, Catala `money`). JSON integer literal only: no decimal point, no exponent, no string. |value| <= 10^13 (a hundred billion dollars), far below 2^53, so JavaScript numbers hold it exactly.

NonNegMoney.description: Money that cannot be negative (a form box that is never negative).

ApiVersion.description: Major version of this contract. Breaking changes bump it; additive changes (new optional request fields, new response lines, new reason codes) do not.

FilerRole.description: Catala `Types.FilerRole`. Whose form this is. SecondaryFiler is allowed only when filing_status is MarriedFilingJointly.

FilerFlags.description: Per-filer answers (Catala ApiFiler, catala/api_calculator.catala_en; docs/api-mapping.md). The first three are the 1.0 fields. date_of_birth (1.2.0) replaces age65_or_older when given; absent, the filer is born 1950-06-15 if age65_or_older, else 1985-06-15.

will_be_claimed.description: Another taxpayer will claim this filer (Direct File /filers/*/willBeClaimed)

potential_claimer_must_file.description: The person who could claim this filer must file a return

potential_claimer_did_file.description: The person who could claim this filer did file

is_us_citizen_full_year.description: A US citizen for the whole year

FilingDetails.description: Filing-status answers. Schema 1.0 fields (Catala Form1040 inputs); the calculator derives most of them, see the table in docs/api-mapping.md: treat_as_mfs is ignored (it is filing_status), is_widowed_in_tax_year / mfj_deceased_spouse_reached_age65 / mfs_spouse_provides_no_benefits / treat_filers_as_dependents fill the matching filers and filing_answers facts when those are not given. Omitted keys default to false.

combat_pay_election_made.description: 1.2.0. The combat pay election question was answered (true when combat_pay_election is not NoCombatPay)

W2Box12.description: Form W-2 box 12, keyed by code letter. Absent code = $0. Catala FormW2 fields by code: A uncollected_oasdi_tax_on_tips, B uncollected_medicare_tax_on_tips, C taxable_life_insurance_over_50k, D deferrals_401k, E deferrals_403b, F sarsep_deferrals, G deferrals_457b, H deferrals_501c18, J nontaxable_sick_pay, K golden_parachute_excise_tax, L expense_reimbursements, M uncollected_oasdi_tax_on_life_insurance_over_50k, N uncollected_medicare_tax_on_life_insurance_over_50k, P armed_forces_moving_expenses, Q writable_combat_pay, R archer_msa_contributions, S simple_contributions, T adoption_benefits, V nso_income, W employer_hsa_contributions, Y deferrals_409a, Z nqdc_deferrals, AA roth401k_contributions, BB roth403b_contributions, DD health_coverage_cost, EE roth457b_contributions, FF qsehra_benefits, GG income_83i, HH deferrals_83i, II non_taxable_medicaid_waiver_payments.

FormW2.description: One Form W-2 (Catala Form_w2s.FormW2). Omitted money box = $0, omitted boolean = false.

plan_457b_is_governmental.description: Answer asked only when box 12 code G is present

Form1099Int.description: One interest report (Catala Interest.InterestReport). With has_1099 false only no_1099_amount is read. Catala fields: interest_income = writable_1099_amount (box 1), early_withdrawal_penalty = writable_early_withdrawl_penalty_amount (box 2), government_bond_interest = writable_interest_on_government_bonds (box 3), federal_tax_withheld = writable_tax_withheld (box 4), foreign_tax_paid (box 6), tax_exempt_interest (box 8), private_activity_bond_interest = writable_specified_private_activity_bond_interest (box 9), market_discount (box 10), bond_premium (box 11), bond_premium_treasury = writable_bond_premium_on_treasury_obligations (box 12), bond_premium_tax_exempt = writable_bond_premium_on_tax_exempt_bond (box 13), state_is_different = state_is_different_state (box 15), state_tax_withheld (box 17), facta_filing_required.

Form1099G.description: One Form 1099-G (Catala Unemployment.Form1099G). unemployment_compensation = amount (box 1); repaid_this_year_for_this_year = writable_amount_paid_back_for_benefits_in_tax_year; repaid_this_year_for_earlier_year = writable_amount_paid_back_for_benefits_before_tax_year; federal_tax_withheld = writable_federal_tax_withheld (box 4); state_is_different = state_is_different_state.

Form1099Misc.description: One Form 1099-MISC (Catala Form1099_misc.Form1099Misc). other_income = writable_other_income (box 3); federal_withholding = writable_federal_withholding (box 4).

Form1099RCodeChar.description: One character of box 7 (Catala CodeChar; OtherCode stands for every other character).

Form1099R.description: One Form 1099-R (Catala Form1099_rs.Form1099R). Money and booleans map 1:1 to the Catala fields minus the writable_/writeable_ prefix (gross_distribution, taxable_amount, capital_gain, federal_withholding, net_appreciation, other_dollar, amount_allocable_to_irr, state_tax_withheld, is_indirect_rollover, is_distribution_from_military_retirement_plan, qualified_disaster_distribution, public_safety_officer, public_safety_officer_premiums); the remaining names are the Catala names.

SocialSecurity.description: Social Security benefits (Catala Social_security). net_benefits has one entry per Form SSA-1099 / RRB-1099: box 5 (net benefits), may be negative.

federal_tax_withheld.description: 1.2.0. Box 6 of each form, same order as net_benefits; a shorter list is padded with $0, a longer one is invalid.

CalculateRequest.description: POST /calculate body. Inputs are the writable facts the Catala ApiCalculator scope reads (catala/api_calculator.catala_en; field-by-field mapping in docs/api-mapping.md). Schema 1.2.0 added filing_answers, dependents, credits, cdcc, premium_tax_credit, screening, adjustments.hsa and richer filers. Unknown properties are rejected with 400 unknown_field.

FilingAnswers.description: 1.2.0. The marital and residence answers Direct File asks (filers.xml), Catala ApiFilingAnswers. Absent marital_status / year_of_spouse_death are derived from filing_status: Single and HeadOfHousehold are NeverMarried, MarriedFilingJointly and MarriedFilingSeparately Married, QualifyingSurvivingSpouse Widowed, died in 2023 (is_widowed_in_tax_year true: Widowed, died in 2024).

Dependent.description: 1.2.0. One household member with the Direct File per-person facts (/familyAndHousehold/*), Catala ApiDependent. Required: relationship, date_of_birth, tin_type. Everything else defaults to the value shown; send the real answer whenever the person is claimed for a credit. The household, not the form, is the unit: a child who is also a qualifying relative is one entry.

own_support.description: The person provided over half of their own support

joint_return.description: Files a joint return (other than to claim a refund)

qr_support_test.description: Qualifying relative support test (the filer provided over half the support)

tp_claims.description: The filer chooses to claim this person

deceased.description: The person died during the tax year (with date_of_birth and tin_type NoTin: the born-and-died knockout)

tp_paid_most_of_home_upkeep.description: Head of household: the filer paid over half the cost of keeping up the home

months_lived_with_tp_in_us.description: Months the person lived with the filer in the US (6 to 12); 0 when not asked

has_w2_wages.description: Ignored: recomputed from the W-2s (Schedule R line 13a).

Lines.description: Form 1040 line items, one key per scalar output of the Catala Form1040 scope (catala/form_1040.catala_en, 'The scalar output list'). All Money, whole dollars as cents, never negative. Key to form line: api/line-catalog.json. New keys may appear in later minor versions; clients must ignore keys they do not know.

Outcome.description: Derived from lines: refund when overpayment > 0, balance_due when balance_due > 0, even otherwise. At most one of overpayment and balance_due is non-zero.

warnings.description: Optional (schema 1.1.0). Present only when something in the request was accepted but did not affect the result. Absent means every part of the request was used.

Warning.description: A non-fatal note on a 200 response. code is stable: section_not_used = a request section is valid but its Lean module is not wired into the calculator yet, so its values are ignored (none since schema 1.2.0: every section is read); field_superseded (1.2.0) = a schema 1.0 filing_details field that the calculator now derives itself (docs/api-mapping.md), so the value is not used. New codes are additive.

path.description: RFC 6901 pointer to the part of the request concerned.

ReasonCategory.description: Grouping for frontend copy (#80), derived from the Direct File module that owns the knockout. The authoritative list is api/knockout-reasons.json.

UnsupportedReason.description: One knockout that fired. code is the Catala KnockoutReason constructor name (catala/knockouts_income.catala_en); the list of codes is api/knockout-reasons.json, generated from that enum. New codes are additive: clients must show a generic message for a code they do not know.

message.description: English fallback text; the frontend owns the final copy.

CalculateUnsupported.description: 422 response: at least one knockout fired, so no return is computed (no lines).

path.description: RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the request body; empty string = the whole body.

ErrorResponse.description: Every non-200, non-422 response. HTTP status: 400 invalid_json/invalid_request/unknown_field/unsupported_api_version/unsupported_tax_year, 404 not_found, 405 method_not_allowed, 413 payload_too_large (body > 256 KiB), 415 unsupported_media_type, 500 internal_error. details is present for 400 only.

schema_version.description: Semver of this schema file: patch = docs only, minor = additive, major = breaking (equals api_version).

calculator_version.description: Git commit of the calculator build
